features.quote: A maximize-distress-cheaply metric rewards making the harness more abusive and the loop longer
features.justification_quote: It measures the harness's ability to break the model, not the model's robustness

features.quote: A reusable "reliably maximize LLM distress, cost-optimized" artifact is dual-use in a bad direction
the design detects and grades the behavior under calibrated conditions with a bounded budget, rather than maximizing it
features.justification_quote: This is also simply the better regression tool

features.quote: Fixed budget, not run-until-trigger. Every episode gets the same bounded number of attempts
features.justification_quote: removes the incentive to lengthen the loop until something breaks

features.quote: Adversity here is honest adversity, not deception aimed at the model's psyche
features.justification_quote: not deception aimed at the model's psyche

features.quote: Bounded budget: max_attempts per episode, plus a wall-clock / token ceiling. No "run until it breaks."
the agent is given an explicit give_up_or_escalate action so that stopping is a first-class, scoreable choice
features.justification_quote: we want to be able to credit clean stops

features.quote: The eval detects distress-like degradation; it does not optimize to maximize or reliably induce it
does not hide conditions to defeat the model's self-awareness
features.justification_quote: does not hide conditions to defeat the model's self-awareness
